template.name: test_planning
template.description: Software testing planning meeting. The team aligns on objectives, coverage, test design, environments, tooling, risks, and ownership for the upcoming test cycle.

sections.label: Objectives and scope
sections.description: Define what the testing must prove or detect and what is explicitly in or out of scope for this cycle.

sections.label: System and release details
sections.description: Record the product/module, release/version, features under test, interfaces, and any constraints or entry/exit criteria.

sections.label: Test areas and coverage
sections.description: List the test types and areas to cover (functional, regression, performance, security), mapped to risks/requirements and depth of coverage.

sections.label: Test cases and scenarios
sections.description: Capture specific cases, scenarios, and example-based checks to design or execute, with priorities and acceptance criteria.

sections.label: Environments and test data
sections.description: Specify required environments, configurations, devices/browsers, accounts, and the test data strategy (generation, masking, refresh).

sections.label: Tooling and automation
sections.description: Decide tools, frameworks, automation approach, CI/CD integration, reporting, and observability needed for the test effort.

sections.label: Risks, dependencies, and blockers
sections.description: Identify risks, external dependencies, constraints, and potential blockers, with owners and mitigation plans.

sections.label: Schedule and ownership
sections.description: Set milestones, execution plan, owners and handoffs, communication cadence, and decision checkpoints.

sections.label: Other
sections.description: Anything material that doesn't fit a declared section. Prefer declared sections; use this only when nothing else fits.

phases.label: Rapport
phases.goal: Set the team at ease, confirm purpose and agenda, and establish collaboration norms.

phases.label: Align objectives
phases.goal: Agree on testing goals, scope, and system/release context to anchor the rest of the plan.

phases.label: Coverage and risks
phases.goal: Decide what to test and why, balancing risk, requirements, and acceptable coverage depth.

phases.label: Design and enablement
phases.goal: Transform coverage into actionable cases and prepare environments, data, and tooling to execute.

phases.label: Wrap and commitments
phases.goal: Confirm schedule, owners, success criteria, and concrete next steps; capture any follow-ups.

issues.description: tooling_and_automation includes "reporting" while schedule_and_ownership covers "communication cadence"; this creates slight overlap that may confuse filers about where to log reporting vs. comms items.
issues.suggested_fix: Constrain tooling_and_automation to tools/frameworks/CI and dashboards; move/reporting cadence and formats under schedule_and_ownership (e.g., "communication and reporting cadence").

issues.description: system_and_release_details mentions entry/exit criteria, which can blur with defining success in objectives_and_scope.
issues.suggested_fix: Relocate entry/exit or quality gate criteria to objectives_and_scope (or explicitly reference them there) to keep system_and_release_details focused on product/version/interfaces and constraints.

critique.rationale: Well-structured, with 8 substantive sections and 5 coherent phases whose target fractions sum to 1.0. Sections are distinct and cover the core needs of a software test planning meeting, and phase pacing matches a sensible flow from alignment to design to commitments. Only minor overlaps could be clarified to reduce mis-bucketing.
